title: ProjectOS Capability Policy
description: Per-project read/write and high-risk policy written to .projectops/capability-policy.json. It states which session profiles the project permits, which operations require an owner permit, and which are refused outright. It contains no credential values and no credential references.

productionFrozen.description: When true (the default), every production-targeting provider action is refused before any credential is considered.

operationClassCredentials.description: Credential names that may only be released for one owner-gated command. Advisory documentation: classification itself is fail-closed in code, so an unlisted name is still treated as operation-class.

ownerPermitRequired.description: Provider actions that always require a specific owner permit, e.g. vercel-production-deploy.

refusedOperations.description: Provider actions this project refuses regardless of permit.

productionServersDisabled.description: Structural: the Supabase MCP server is never enabled for production.
